svg.title: KELNA 0.14 — F.Cu, component-side view
svg.desc: Native KiCad copper, pads, vias and exact drill geometry. Primary-layer copper only; no opposite-layer overlay. Native silkscreen for the viewed side. Dark zones, vivid tracks, gold through-hole pads, grey via annuli. Board-cropped view.
